name: How do I choose the best accessible flooring for my kitchen or bathroom?

mainEntity.name: How do I choose the best accessible flooring for my kitchen or bathroom?

acceptedAnswer.text: For kitchens and bathrooms, accessible flooring choices prioritize water resistance, slip resistance, and ease of cleaning. Non-slip vinyl, linoleum, and porcelain or ceramic tiles with a textured, matte finish are excellent options. These materials can withstand moisture without becoming excessively slippery and are durable enough for high-traffic areas. Avoid polished or highly glazed tiles, which can be very slick when wet. Consider the overall design and ensure any grout lines are minimal and smooth to prevent issues with mobility devices.
acceptedAnswer.description: Best accessible flooring for kitchens/bathrooms: water-resistant, slip-resistant, easy-to-clean options like non-slip vinyl, linoleum, or textured porcelain/ceramic tiles. Avoid polished surfaces.
